name: WAITS_FOR_OPERATION_COMPLETION
definition: A subsequent agent action pauses, polls, or otherwise waits for a previously initiated long-running or asynchronous operation to finish, instead of proceeding while that operation is still in progress.
source_description: An earlier agent action that initiated a long-running or asynchronous operation whose completion has not yet been observed.
target_description: A subsequent agent action that pauses, polls, or waits until the previously initiated operation has finished.

name: PERFORMS_ADDITIONAL_VERIFICATION_FOR_UNCHECKED_REQUIREMENT
definition: After one or more requirements have already been verified, the agent performs a separate, independent verification action targeted at a different requirement that has not yet been checked.
source_description: A completed verification action that confirmed one or more task requirements.
target_description: A subsequent, separate verification action performed to check a different requirement not covered by the earlier verification.

name: PROCEEDS_AFTER_SUCCESS_CONFIRMATION
definition: An observation confirming that a preceding operation completed successfully enables the agent to advance to the next stage of its task, rather than requiring the prior operation to be repeated, repaired, or re-planned.
source_description: An observation reporting that a preceding operation finished successfully.
target_description: A subsequent agent action that advances to the next stage of the task on the basis of that success confirmation.

name: PLAN_IMPLEMENTED_BY_TOOL_CALL
definition: An operation stated in the agent's reasoning as the next step is carried out by a subsequent tool call that performs that stated operation.
source_description: An agent thought, analysis, or plan that states an operation to be performed next.
target_description: A tool call that executes the operation stated in the preceding reasoning.

name: USES_OBSERVED_CONTENT_AS_EVIDENCE_FOR_CLASSIFICATION
definition: The agent interprets content returned by a tool as evidence and uses it to assign the observed document or entity to a category.
source_description: A tool observation containing the document text or extracted content to be interpreted.
target_description: An agent classification decision that assigns the observed document or entity to a category.

name: EXTRACTS_FIELD_VALUES_FROM_OBSERVED_CONTENT
definition: The agent identifies specific labeled or quantitative field values within content returned by a tool and records them as extracted results.
source_description: A tool observation containing content with embedded labeled or quantitative field values.
target_description: An agent result or decision that records the field values extracted from the observed content.

name: OBSERVED_CONFLICTING_VALUES_TRIGGER_PRECEDENCE_RULE
definition: When an observation presents multiple differing candidate values for the same logical field, the agent applies a precedence or disambiguation rule to select the value to use.
source_description: A tool observation containing multiple differing candidate values for the same requested field.
target_description: An agent selection decision that chooses one candidate value by applying a precedence or disambiguation rule.

name: PARTIAL_OBSERVATION_TRIGGERS_FOLLOW_UP_INSPECTION
definition: An observation that exposes only part of the content required for the current analysis causes the agent to perform a follow-up action that retrieves the remaining or fuller content of the same target.
source_description: A tool observation that reveals or provides only a partial view of the content needed for the current analysis.
target_description: A subsequent agent action that retrieves additional or complete content of the same target.

name: CLEANS_UP_TEMPORARY_RESOURCES
definition: After the main task objective has been achieved and its outcome confirmed, a subsequent agent action removes temporary or intermediate resources that were created during execution and are no longer needed.
source_description: A state or confirmation indicating that the main task objective has been completed.
target_description: A subsequent cleanup action that deletes temporary or intermediate resources created during execution.

name: GENERALIZES_VERIFIED_METHOD_TO_BATCH
definition: After a method, command, or procedure has been verified to work on an initial probe or test item, the agent applies the same verified method to process a batch of additional items.
source_description: An observation confirming that a method or procedure succeeded on an initial probe or test item.
target_description: A subsequent agent action that applies the verified method to a batch of remaining items.

name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUOUS_VALUE_WITH_REFERENCE_SOURCE
definition: The agent detects an unknown, placeholder, or ambiguous value within previously retrieved data and queries a separate authoritative or reference source to determine the correct value to use.
source_description: Previously retrieved data containing an unknown, placeholder, or ambiguous value that must be resolved before it can be used.
target_description: A subsequent agent action that queries an external authoritative or reference source to obtain the correct value for the ambiguous or placeholder entry.

name: VALIDATES_AGAINST_EXPECTED_REFERENCE
definition: A subsequent verification action compares a newly derived output against an expected reference value or artifact that was established during an earlier execution step, in order to confirm that a generation or transformation preserved the expected content.
source_description: An expected reference value, artifact, or intermediate product established by an earlier execution step, against which a derived output is to be compared.
target_description: A comparison or validation action that checks the derived output against that expected reference to confirm transformation fidelity.

name: INVESTIGATES_AMBIGUOUS_OBSERVATION
definition: A subsequent agent action is performed to clarify or resolve an ambiguity, inconsistency, or unclear interpretation in an earlier observation, so that the observation can be correctly understood or used.
source_description: An earlier observed execution result whose meaning, units, format, or interpretation is ambiguous, inconsistent, or unclear.
target_description: A subsequent investigative or information-gathering action intended to clarify, disambiguate, or interpret that observation.
